name: Salt Harbor
description: A fogbound fishing port where the lighthouse has gone dark and its keeper has not been seen for nine days. The harbor guild says he left; the night watch says nothing.
rules: There is no magic: nothing happens that could not happen in 1887.
Nobody in the town carries a firearm.

opening_message.text: The evening ferry noses into the pier through a wall of fog. The lighthouse above the town should be turning by now; it is not.
You are the keeper's girl, aren't you? Come in out of the fog before the bell rings.

alternate_openings.title: A reporter at the inn
alternate_openings.text: You have been at the Anchor & Lamp for two days, and the landlord still will not talk about the lighthouse.
